messages:
marc: Heads-up — after we rolled driver 552.16 + CUDA 14.2 to us-west-2-gpu1 last night, a subset of heterogeneous pods started seeing NCCL topology fallbacks. NVLink edges reported missing and throughput for multi-GPU jobs drops ~3-4x. Anyone seen this pattern?

anna: saw it on a few L40/H100 mixes in stage too. Perf regression reproducible with nccl-tests all_reduce across GPUs 0/1 on those nodes. Logs show nvlink detection warnings then SHM/socket fallback. :frowning:

marc: sample `nvidia-smi topo -m` from an affected host (redacted IDs):
```
=============
GPU0    GPU1    CPU Affinity
GPU0    X      NV1     0-15
GPU1    NV1    X       0-15
NV1 indicates NVLINK missing between 0 and 1
```

jason: can you paste kernel and module details? We pushed a kernel module rebuild with updated iommu config in the same deploy. Might be an ordering/rmmod problem.

marc: kernel=6.4.12-100.rw, nvidia-driver=552.16, nvidia-modprobe=525.60, NCCL=2.19.6. `modinfo nvidia` shows taints and `dmesg` has a couple pci probe timing WARNs.

eng-oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1987 — p2p topology regressions (us-west-2). Assigned: @infra-sre.

ryan: quick debugging tips we tried: set `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` to get more verbose topology logs, run `nccl-tests (ib_allreduce/all_reduce)` pinned to GPU pairs. Also checked `lspci -vvv` — bus ordering changed on some nodes after the driver install which can confuse nvlink probe heuristics.

anna: log snippet: 
```
[03/17/2026 02:12:34] NCCL WARN ncclTopoDetect : nvlink edge missing between 0 and 1, falling back to SHM
[03/17/2026 02:12:34] SHM   WARN shmOpen: failed to open /dev/shm/nccl-...: No such file or directory
[03/17/2026 02:12:34] NET   INFO socket init
```

marc: interesting — fallback chain is NVLINK -> SHM -> SOCKET. The SHM step also errors on some hosts which forces SOCKET. That explains the large perf drop. Seems constrained to mixed L40/H100 pairs; homogeneous H100 clusters look fine.

jason: two hypotheses: 1) kernel/PCI bus ordering change is causing nvlink probe to miss edges for some cross-sku peer pairs, 2) a subtle change in the driver’s peer-access enablement on mixed hardware.

ryan: mitigation plan in the short term: 1) pin heavy multi-GPU jobs away from mixed nodes via scheduler placement rule, 2) create a canary rollback to driver 550.12 on a small pool and run nccl-tests to confirm improvement. I've already spun up a canary group in us-west-2.

marc: for scheduler mitigation, we can label nodes with `gpu.topology=mixed` and add placement policy to avoid them for >1 GPU allocations. I'll open a PR against cluster-autoscaler and k8s-node-selector.

anna: also adding a short-term pod env override to surface debug: `env: - name: NCCL_DEBUG value: WARN` and mount a sidecar to collect /var/log/nvidia-installer.log + dmesg.

jason: vendor escalation queued — will file with NVIDIA svcs. Need: pci/topology dumps, `nvidia-smi topo -m`, `dmesg`, `modinfo nvidia`, and one failing nccl-test run. Please collect and attach to ticket.

infra-sre: I pushed a dashboard that counts NCCL fallbacks using logs (search for "ncclTopoDetect" and fallback keywords) and an alert threshold at 5% of multi-gpu jobs in a region. Link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/xxxx.

marc: next steps:
- collect artifacts from affected nodes (dmesg, /var/log/nvidia-installer.log, topo outputs) — infra-sre to run an automated gather script
- run nccl-tests 2.14 and 2.11 on canary rollback to compare
- route multi-gpu jobs away from mixed nodes via label/taint (PR in flight)
- vendor bug with attached artifacts (jason)

ryan: status update — canary rollback to driver 550.12 started on a 10-node pool. Early runs show NVLINK edges restored and all_reduce latency back to expected baseline. Will expand if stable. :thumbsup:

eng-oncall-bot: Update logged to INC-2026-1987 at 1841234595: canary rollback in progress, monitoring performance metrics.

marc: thanks everyone. Keep dumps coming and please don't schedule heavy jobs on mixed nodes until rollback is validated. We'll reconvene if vendor responds or canary fails.
